verdict.rationale: The features page briefly names an 'audit trail' as a Zoho Books capability, but the evidence pack gives no detail on what it captures (user, timestamp, field-level changes) or its coverage across the entire ledger/multi-entity setup — it's a single passing mention alongside unrelated features like custom reports. missing for 10: documentation of audit trail granularity (who/what/when), screenshots or hands-on verification, coverage confirmation across multiple organizations/entities, and independent corroboration.
